candidates.statement: A decision-oriented comparison of post-2100 persistence conditions is not supplied by a single frozen, component-resolved protocol that simultaneously evaluates fertility, mortality, migration, and explicitly uncertain climate-disruption modifiers.

Projection comparison is often communicated as competing headline totals; a transparent decomposition of peak persistence into component contributions, calibration, and decision thresholds is needed for falsifiable evaluation.
No existing population projection handles uncertainty.
Climate effects on fertility, mortality, and migration can be identified coherently at global scale from historical aggregate data alone.
